parameters.name: cascadingDelete
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to cascade delete security group rules is enabled. Valid values:
- true: Cascade delete security group rules.
- false: Do not cascade delete security group rules.

parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway.

parameters.name: securityGroupRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway security rule.
